meaning: A speaker that connects to the internet and answers when you talk to it.
clues: It is a connected device that can respond when you speak to it.
It is a room speaker that connects to the internet and answers out loud without a screen.
You can ask it to play music, give facts, or work with another device.
It usually has microphones and a mute switch or button for times you want quiet.
Its name has two words and starts with S.
assumes: A loudspeaker only plays sound that another device sends it
A smart display has a screen as well as speakers
A phone is a handheld device used for calls and apps

decoys.meaning: A device that turns an electrical signal into sound so you can hear music or speech.
An internet device with a screen that can show facts and play sound.
A handheld device for calls, messages, web use, and apps.
